name: US-China Tariff Escalation
description: The United States has imposed an additional 45% tariff on all industrial equipment and components imported from China, effective immediately. China has announced retaliatory tariffs on US energy sector exports. This impacts all procurement through Chinese manufacturers and transshipment through Chinese ports.

emergencyActions: Expedite all pending POs with Neway Valve before tariff enforcement date
Issue RFQs to Emerson (Fisher valves, US) and IMI CCI (Italy) for valve replacements
Evaluate Indian valve manufacturers (L&T Valves, Audco) for non-critical service valves
Review existing inventory for Chinese-origin equipment that can be repurposed
Engage trade counsel to explore tariff exemption applications for project-critical items
